## 🐾 We Need Your Help

**225 animals** need accurate **weight**, **speed**, and **bite force** data.

| Field | Unit | Example |
|-------|------|---------|
| `weight_kg` | kilograms | 45 |
| `speed_mps` | meters/sec | 17.8 (km/h ÷ 3.6) |
| `bite_force_psi` | PSI | 400 (0 if none) |

## How to Contribute
1. Pick any unchecked animal below
2. Research & update `animal_stats.json`
3. Submit a PR
